scope: Offline pending risk-review decision contract, synthetic unit tests, and the existing ledger/card-resolution code needed to interpret the contract.
evidence_class: Implementation and synthetic contract tests only; not a research outcome or evidence of real-source, notification, or delivery performance.
formal_v2_alignment_result: NOT_ESTABLISHED; exact private Mac V2 specification was not available in this workspace.
real_notification_delivery: NOT_RUN; output contract explicitly records NOT_DELIVERED.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest -q tests.test_pending_risk_review_resolution tests.test_alert_action_experiment tests.test_event_card_integration

path_rule: All file paths are repository-relative POSIX paths. Resolve them from the Mac Git checkout root only; do not reuse cloud workspace absolute paths.
verification_rule: Verify each listed byte length and SHA-256 before restoring. The manifest itself is intentionally excluded from its file list.
